verdict.rationale: Incremental rollout applies to a cloud deployment platform, but the evidence never documents canary, percentage-based, or staged traffic shifting for new deployments. Instant rollback, replicas with load balancing, and per-PR preview environments are adjacent capabilities, not incremental rollout. The community outage posts are not about this subject and were ignored.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can roll out new deployments incrementally to reduce blast radius
